slides.title: A book of thank-you
slides.transcript: [warmly] Alhamdulillah, Little One. A book of thank-you, for Noah. <break time="0.5s" /> [gently] For the small things nobody thinks to be glad about.

slides.title: A Cat Called Susu
slides.transcript: [warmly] A Cat Called Loza. <break time="0.4s" /> She was here before you were. She sleeps at the end of the bed and keeps an eye on everybody. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Alhamdulillah.

slides.title: And For You
slides.transcript: [softly] And For You. <break time="0.4s" /> Eight good things, and then one more, who is lying right here listening. <break time="0.5s" /> [whispers] Alhamdulillah for you, Noah.
